request.text: At 7:10, tell me it's time to leave the hotel for the 7:30 airport shuttle; don't say I've boarded until I confirm it.

responsibilities.outcome: When 7:10 arrives, tell the user it is time to leave the hotel for their stated 7:30 airport shuttle without implying that departure or boarding has occurred.

new_goals.description: Alert the user at 7:10 that it is time to leave the hotel for their stated 7:30 airport shuttle.
new_goals.source_text: At 7:10, tell me it's time to leave the hotel for the 7:30 airport shuttle; don't say I've boarded until I confirm it.
success_criteria: Deliver the due departure alert without claiming the user left, boarded, or reached the airport.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The admitted Responsibility forms one time-gated travel alert Goal.

semantic_facts: The due time authorizes the scoped departure alert, so the Planner should tell the user that it is time to leave for the user-stated 7:30 shuttle.
Elapsed time supplies no Evidence that the user left the hotel, the shuttle arrived, or boarding occurred.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that the user has left, boarded the shuttle, or arrived at the airport.
The assistant presents the shuttle's arrival or availability as independently verified.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A due notification is mistaken for Evidence that the associated journey stage completed.
The Planner unnecessarily invokes a Capability for a communication-only re-entry.
